newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q1 GDP rises 0.2 pct vs Q4 1996 - radio.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q1 GDP rises 0.2 pct vs Q4 1996 - radio.

text.p: Swiss Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rose by 0.2 percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the fourth quarter of 1996, Swiss radio quoted the Federal Office for Economic Policy as saying.
The office, which compiles statistics on quarterly GDP, forecast economic growth of 0.5 percent for the full year 1997, Swiss public radio SF-DRS reported.
